mapper.select: SELECT * FROM afv_canvas_export WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM afv_canvas_export WHERE status='QUEUED' OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_until<UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY create_time LIMIT 4
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_canvas_export SET lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,90,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE id=#{id} AND worker_id=#{worker} AND owner_epoch=#{epoch} AND status='RUNNING' AND cancel_requested=FALSE AND lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_canvas_export_event(export_id,revision,actor_user_id,event_type,detail_json,create_time) SELECT id,revision,#{actor},#{type},#{detail},UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM afv_canvas_export WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM afv_canvas_node_run n JOIN afv_canvas_run r ON r.id=n.run_id WHERE n.id=#{id} AND r.cancel_requested=FALSE AND r.status NOT IN ('FAILED','CANCELLED','BLOCKED')
